questions.stem: An amino acid is incorporated into enzyme of glutathione peroxidase. This amino acid is encoded by a codon that typically signals translation termination but, under specific conditions, is repurposed to allow incorporation during the elongation phase of protein synthesis. The process requires a specialized insertion sequence in the mRNA. Which of the following best describes this amino acid and how it is incorporated?

options.label: A
options.text: Selenocysteine, incorporated cotranslationally via the UGA codon

options.label: B
options.text: Hydroxylysine, formed by hydroxylation of lysine residues post-translation

options.label: C
options.text: Selenocysteine, incorporated cotranslationally via the UAA codon

options.label: D
options.text: Selenocysteine incorporated post-translationally via the UAG codon
